h1: Custom Rainbow Beanies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom rainbow beanies in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for Pride events, team spirit, and brand visibility.
introHtml: Rainbow beanies let you show support for diversity and inclusion while keeping your team warm. Made from soft acrylic or cotton blends, these custom beanies can be embroidered or screen printed with your logo. They are popular for Pride parades, company events, and fundraising campaigns. Choose from adult or youth sizes and add your branding in bold colors that match the rainbow palette.
heroAltText: Custom rainbow beanie with embroidered logo on a mannequin, showing vibrant stripes
